action_legality_checks.policy_evidence: For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option. There cannot be any change of product types, e.g. modify shirt to shoe.
action_legality_checks.conversation_evidence: User requested to remove the luggage set from a pending order without replacing it with another variant of the same product.
action_legality_checks.reasoning: The attempted action was to remove an item from a pending order without exchanging it for another variant of the same product, which is not supported by policy. The modify_pending_order_items tool can only be used to exchange items for other variants, not to remove items outright.
action_legality_checks.correct_action: Inform the user that removing an item from a pending order is not supported; offer to cancel the order or exchange the item for another variant.
